Carrier, such as "AC", "DC", "heat" or "gas".
Unit of the bus' carrier if the implicitly assumed unit ("MW") is inappropriate (e.g. "t/h"). Only descriptive. Does not influence any PyPSA functions.

Column scaling factor of the bus in the optimisation, i.e. the solver unit of the bus relative to its model unit (e.g. `1e-3` turns MW into GW). Applies to the dispatch and capacity variables of attached one-ports and of branches starting at the bus (`bus0`) and to its nodal balance row. Solutions and duals are reported in original units.
Location of the bus. Does not influence the optimisation model but can be used for aggregation with `n.statistics`.
